evals.prompt: Can you make an app icon for Tidepool? It's my little Mac menu bar app that shows tide times for my local beach. It's a SwiftPM project built with build.sh, no Xcode project. Teal accent, dark UI. Wire it into the build too.
evals.expected_output: Icon/Tidepool.icon with per-layer SVGs and at most four groups, Icon/previews/sheet.png showing four renditions plus small sizes, actool accepts the bundle, build.sh compiles the icon and Info.plist has both icon keys, Icon/README.md written, opaque marketing PNG.

evals.prompt: The Ledgerline icon looks off. The orange dot comes out pale next to the page, and in tinted mode it basically vanishes. The bundle is in Icon/Ledgerline.icon. Fix it and show me all four renditions.
evals.expected_output: Orange dot in its own top group with glass off so it stays saturated, a tinted fill override so it is visible in TintedLight and TintedDark, a contact sheet of the four renditions, actool accepts the bundle.
